species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 59°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 14–36 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
Southeast wind at 24 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
